subject: Certification playbook: roles, sample requests, and evidence queue
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Certification playbook: roles, sample requests, and evidence queue

Team,

As we move toward the H2 audit cadence I want to lock down a small certification playbook we can reuse across ISO/FedRAMP/SOC2 scopes. High-level asks:

- Owners: confirm who owns each control family (IAM, Logging, Change Mgmt, Data Protection) and point people for evidence collection.
- Sample requests: compile the minimum artifacts auditors ask for (config screenshots, policy docs, sample logs) and owners’ locations.
- Evidence queue: a single shared drive folder + naming convention; naive suggestion: /Cert/Evidence/{account}/{control_family}/{artifact}-{YYYYMMDD}.

Please review the attached initial checklist and reply with: 1) control families you own, 2) any required external contacts (Acme, ControlShield), and 3) a realistic ETA for first artifact upload. Goal: have owners and the skeleton playbook by EOD Mon 7/19 so we can give ControlShield a scoped evidence bundle next week.

Notes: Acme is pushing to align their SOC2 re-audit window with our ISO assessment; we should be pragmatic about sample windows.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial-checklist.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Certification playbook: roles, sample requests, and evidence queue

Thanks — good call. Quick notes:

- I can own Logging & Monitoring controls (audit logs, retention, alerting proof). I will populate the evidence-matrix with locations and sample names.
- Lauren: can you take Change Management (tickets + deployment approvals)?
- Naomi: can you coordinate with ControlShield on their SIG/CAIQ baseline so we avoid duplicate exports?

I attached an evidence-matrix prototype. Column highlights: control, owner, artifact example, sample window, path in Drive, redaction notes.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: ControlShield Audit <audits@controlshield.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG/CAIQ — initial question pack for scoping

Forwarding the initial SIG/CAIQ packet ControlShield sent. A few items look duplicative of our SOC2 evidence but they ask for specific control mappings and cloud config extracts. ControlShield requested a brief scoping call to confirm which artifacts they require for the ISO proof matrix.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: ControlShield Audit <audits@controlshield.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Subject: SIG/CAIQ initial question pack

Hi Naomi,

Attached is a short SIG/CAIQ checklist to help us scope the assessment. Could you confirm these items:

1) Evidence for IAM: list of privileged roles, sample IAM policy JSON, and a recent access review report.
2) Logging: egress and platform logging retention policy and two sampled log files (redacted).
3) Software change management: PR->deploy pipeline proof and one sample change ticket with approvals.
4) Encryption: key management description and a sample KMS policy (where keys are stored).

If you can send a secure link to the evidence bundle and propose 2x 30-minute windows next week for a scoping call, we’ll confirm the minimal scope that still covers CAIQ and ISO control mapping.

Regards,
Sasha Park
Engagement Lead
ControlShield Audit

Attachment: sig-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

--- End forwarded message ---

Naomi

Attachment: sig-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: Sasha Park <audits@controlshield.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ — initial question pack for scoping

Hi Naomi / Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for forwarding. We reviewed the evidence-matrix and the checklist. Two quick clarifications before the scoping call:

- For IAM, the auditors want one example of a privilege escalation ticket plus the JSON policy for the role bound to admin access. If you have a sanitized sample, that will be sufficient.
- For logging, please provide 48 hours of platform logs (redacted IPs) and the retention policy doc. We don’t need a full year; samples are fine for mapping control effectiveness.

Next steps:
1) Please upload a single zipped evidence bundle to the shared Drive link you control and share a secure view-only link.
2) Propose two 30-minute windows (we prefer 8:30–11:00 PT). I can do Wed 7/21 9:00 or Thu 7/22 10:30 PT.

Also, a small ask — if you have a canonical control owner list in a CSV, share that; it speeds mapping.

Regards,
Sasha Park
Engagement Lead
ControlShield Audit

Related: DocuSign engagement LOA (https://docusign.com/link/LOA-ACME-REDWOOD)
